descripcion: Foto real de un espacio cotidiano (espejo del baño, refrigerador, escritorio) con un solo post-it pegado junto al producto o sobre él, con un mensaje corto escrito a mano con plumón. Íntimo, auténtico y muy efectivo para detener el scroll; el post-it es el único texto de la imagen.
reference_style: Authentic photographic still life of the product in a real home or work setting with a single handwritten sticky note as the only message, personal and unpolished yet beautifully lit

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The sticky note with its handwritten message: a bright square that catches the eye first. 2) The product, sharp and right next to the note. 3) The real-life setting that gives context (surface, mirror, fridge, desk).
art_direction.composition_style: Real photograph, eye-level or slightly elevated camera (about 15-20 degrees down), 50mm lens look. Asymmetric two-subject composition: the sticky note in the upper-left area, stuck on a vertical surface (mirror, fridge door, wall, cabinet or monitor), and the product standing on the horizontal surface in the right-center, slightly in front of that vertical surface. Note and product are close enough to read as one scene. Alternative when the product has a large flat front (box, big jar, laptop or phone for digital products): the note is stuck directly on the product, covering at most 30% of its front and never its brand name or main label.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Sticky note about 38-40% of the canvas width (square), around x 8-47% and y 8-47%, rotated 3-6 degrees, with about 3% inner padding. Product about 50-56% of the canvas height, around x 52-88% and y 34-90%, its base resting at about y 88%. The line where the vertical and horizontal surfaces meet sits at about y 58-65%. Keep 5-6% margins; the rest of the room is softly blurred background.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft natural window light from the left, warm daylight color temperature, gentle real shadows: the note casts a faint shadow on its surface and its bottom edge curls slightly away from it; the product has a soft contact shadow. Shallow depth of field: note and product in sharp focus, the rest of the room softly blurred. Realistic, slightly imperfect, editorial photo feel; no studio backdrop.

layout_summary: Square real photo of an everyday setting (bathroom vanity with mirror, kitchen counter by the fridge, or home-office desk with a monitor). A single square sticky note is stuck on the vertical surface in the upper-left area, slightly tilted, with a short handwritten marker message, a tiny sign-off and one small doodle. The user's product stands on the counter or desk in the right-center, sharp, label facing the camera, close to the note. The background is softly blurred. No graphic text, frames or overlays.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Real-life context that makes the note feel like a genuine personal moment
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Choose the setting that matches the product's real moment of use: bathroom mirror and vanity for cosmetics and personal care, kitchen counter and fridge door for supplements, food and home products, desk with a monitor for gadgets, digital products and services, bedroom dresser for clothing and accessories, kids' shelf for toys. Use the setting from the batch plan so variations differ. Tidy, a few soft-focus everyday objects, nothing that competes with the product.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Upper-left area, about x 8-47% and y 8-47%, rotated 3-6 degrees, stuck on the vertical surface
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: The ad's only message; reads as a personal reminder, tip or gift note
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Square paper sticky note with matte paper texture, a slightly curled bottom edge and a faint shadow. Color: classic pastel yellow, or a pastel tint from the brand palette if the batch plan says so. Written with a thick felt-tip marker.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Inside the note, under or beside the message
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Adds personal warmth and can point the eye toward the product
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: One small doodle drawn with the same marker: an underline, a small heart, a sun, a star, or a short arrow pointing toward the product. Only one.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Right-center, about x 52-88% and y 34-90%, standing on the horizontal surface
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows exactly what the note is about; the commercial anchor
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Render the user's product exactly as in the attached product photo (same geometry, packaging, label and colors), front or slight 3/4 view, label facing the camera, sharp, at a realistic scale for the setting, with a soft contact shadow. For digital products or services, show the product's screen on a phone or laptop on the desk and stick the note on the screen's bezel.

text_layers.reference_position: On the sticky note, upper and middle area of the note
text_layers.text_style: Handwritten felt-tip marker lettering, casual but clearly legible (print style, not cursive), dark ink (near-black, deep navy or the darkest brand color), letters about 4.5-5.5% of the canvas height, loosely left-aligned or centered on the note, max 4 short lines (about 12-14 characters each) filling about 70% of the note
text_layers.guia_texto: Mensaje corto y personal escrito a mano: recordatorio de rutina ('Tómalo antes del café'), consejo, nota de regalo o advertencia con humor ('No toques mi ___'). 3 a 8 palabras; ideal 4 a 6, para que la letra se lea grande.

text_layers.reference_position: Bottom-right corner of the sticky note
text_layers.text_style: Same marker handwriting, smaller (about 3-3.5% of the canvas height), 1 line, right-aligned
text_layers.guia_texto: Firma breve que da contexto emocional: '— Mamá', '— Yo del futuro', una inicial. 1 a 3 palabras. Omitir si el mensaje ya ocupa las 4 líneas.

mandatory_visual_elements: One square sticky note with a handwritten marker message, slightly tilted and curled
One small hand-drawn doodle on the note
The user's product, sharp, right next to the note (or with the note stuck on it)
Real everyday setting with natural window light and a softly blurred background
forbidden_additions: Graphic headline or typed text overlays
Rating stars, reviews or testimonial cards
Additional sticky notes, paper notes or printed labels
Studio seamless backdrop or flat brand-colored background
Bottom bar, banner or graphic frame
Cluttered props that compete with the product
notas_paleta: Colores naturales de la escena, armonizados con la paleta de marca: la marca aparece en detalles del entorno (toalla, taza, pared, objetos) y, si el plan lo indica, en el color del post-it como tinte pastel. La tinta puede ser el color más oscuro de la marca. Nunca fondos planos de color de marca.
